data.title: Review exact profiler child/source integration
data.description: risk:high — supersedes cr-3egix3 and all earlier overlay reviews. Review exact commit 300c4d5dd1c925036579a10dd06eee2ed8a59854, tree 21902c80a1dbf18bf9bdc347f7f706e785d6defc. Check evidence forgery/TOCTOU and exact integration: C source-approved one-hour Tokio blocking keepalive, one measured spawn_blocking site/zero other birth sites, exact profile_role_lifetime in approval and binary contract; CPU and CPU-smoke-only exact permission + three inherited FD ownership; child disable at t1, exact ACK, shared-offset ledger append, measured event/null/omission semantics; typed relative trace templates source/prepared-bound and runtime-derived to disjoint canonical absolute store paths including B empty metadata. Hostile static selftest 5/5, Python AST, exact historical C source proof, Rust parser, profiler contract comparison, and diff check pass. Do not run Cargo, rustc, builds, stage-locks, contract/correctness execution, benchmarks, profiling, timing, or decisions. Do not self-approve.

data.body: HIGH: The emitted approval/prepared schema identities do not match the exact downstream authority. This commit fixes APPROVAL_SCHEMA to  and PREPARED_SCHEMA to  (and the static self-test asserts them), but evidence_schema.py requires  / ; exact runner commit 5f6544c rejects the prepared top-level identity at run_rebaseline.py:996-1001 and the approval at 1139-1145. Therefore the prepared root produced here cannot enter the reviewed runner. Converge these identities on one shared authority and add a static producer-to-loader contract test before re-review.

HIGH: The typed trace-template materialization is incompatible with the exact runner checkpoint. These values are JSON arrays of  objects, while runner commit 5f6544c at run_rebaseline.py:3692 calls  and 3694 requires every value to be a string. The first syscall/structural trace plan therefore raises TypeError ( is unhashable) before a child runs. Keep the typed contract, but supersede the runner parser with exact typed-object validation/resolution (including B's empty metadata family) and cross-test this prepared output against that loader.

Correction with literal identities: producer uses asterism-rebaseline-source-approval-v3 and asterism-rebaseline-prepared-v3; downstream authority requires bn-2l3n-source-approval-v3 and bn-2l3n-prepared-artifacts-v3.

Correction with literal shapes: producer emits arrays of objects with exactly kind and path; runner calls set(values), then requires each value to be a string. A dict value is unhashable, so the trace plan raises TypeError.

data.reason: Two HIGH integration failures. The producer schema identities differ from the exact shared runner/evaluator authority, so prepared artifacts fail at admission. Typed trace marker objects also reach a runner parser that accepts strings and calls set on the list, so trace planning raises TypeError. Failure modes are fail-stop before row zero, not bad measurements. Edge cases checked include CPU smoke, unavailable and non-CPU descriptor omission, C lifetime, and B empty metadata. Rollback is safe because no measurement has run; retain the prior approved tooling or supersede this checkpoint. Add producer-to-loader schema and typed-marker static checks as pre-measurement monitoring. Input validation must share exact schema identities and validate canonical typed objects end to end.
